277071421_36425ce9.text: Semilunar granule cells (SGCs): These are sparse dentate gyrus glutamatergic projection neurons with unique morphological and physiological properties that distinguish them from regular granule cells (Dovek et al., 2025)(Williams et al., 2007).

277071421_aa3dfd95.text: SGCs receive stronger medial entorhinal cortex and associational synaptic drive but lack the short-term facilitation of lateral entorhinal cortex inputs observed in granule cells (Dovek et al., 2025).
